words.enDefinition: a material whose electrical conductivity can be varied substantially by factors such as temperature, light or impurity content

examples.en: The examples show how light can change the conductivity of a semiconductor used in a detector.
examples.zh: 示例表明，光照能够改变探测器中「半导体」的导电性。

examples.en: We compared a silicon semiconductor with a metal to understand why their conductivities respond differently to temperature.
examples.zh: 我们比较硅「半导体」与金属，以理解两者的电导率对温度的响应为何不同。

words.enDefinition: a semiconductor in which thermally generated electrons and holes occur in equal concentrations without appreciable impurity effects

examples.en: The intrinsic semiconductor model predicts equal concentrations of electrons and holes at the same temperature.
examples.zh: 「本征半导体」模型预测，在同一温度下电子与空穴的浓度相等。

examples.en: Our diagram starts with an intrinsic semiconductor to show what changes when donor atoms are added.
examples.zh: 图中先从「本征半导体」出发，展示加入施主原子后发生的变化。

collocations: carrier concentration in an intrinsic semiconductor

words.enDefinition: a semiconductor whose charge carrier concentrations are substantially affected by introduced impurity atoms

examples.en: The extrinsic semiconductor had unequal electron and hole concentrations because of the added donor atoms.
examples.zh: 加入施主原子后，该「杂质半导体」的电子与空穴浓度不相等。

examples.en: We compared an extrinsic semiconductor with pure silicon to examine how added impurities affect electrical behavior.
examples.zh: 我们将「杂质半导体」与纯硅比较，探究加入杂质怎样影响电学行为。

collocations: majority carriers in an extrinsic semiconductor

words.enDefinition: an added atom that can supply an electron to the conduction band of a semiconductor

examples.en: Our band diagram shows a donor impurity level lying close to the conduction band in silicon.
examples.zh: 硅的能带图显示，「施主杂质」的能级靠近导带。

examples.en: An ionized donor impurity leaves a fixed positive charge after its electron enters the conduction band.
examples.zh: 「施主杂质」失去电子后会成为固定的正电荷，电子进入导带。

words.enDefinition: an added atom that can accept a valence electron and leave a mobile hole in a semiconductor

examples.en: The drawing shows a neutral acceptor impurity becoming negatively charged after capturing a valence electron.
examples.zh: 图中显示，一个中性的「受主杂质」俘获价电子后带上负电。

examples.en: The tutor used an acceptor impurity to explain why the silicon model had additional mobile holes.
examples.zh: 老师用「受主杂质」解释为什么在硅模型中出现更多可移动的空穴。

words.enDefinition: a semiconductor in which electrons are the majority mobile charge carriers

examples.en: Electrons carry most of the current through the n-type semiconductor in this simplified conductivity calculation.
examples.zh: 在这一简化的电导率计算中，电子承担了「n 型半导体」中的大部分电流。

examples.en: We labeled the donor-doped side an n-type semiconductor because it had more electrons than holes.
examples.zh: 我们把施主掺杂的一侧标成「n 型半导体」，因为这一侧的电子多于空穴。

words.enDefinition: a semiconductor in which holes are the majority mobile charge carriers

examples.en: The p-type semiconductor contains more mobile holes than conduction electrons under the stated equilibrium conditions.
examples.zh: 在给定平衡条件下，「p 型半导体」的可移动空穴多于导带电子。

examples.en: We shaded the p-type semiconductor on the diagram to distinguish it from the donor-doped side.
examples.zh: 我们将图中的「p 型半导体」涂上阴影，以便与施主掺杂的一侧区别。

words.enDefinition: a mobile particle or quasiparticle, such as an electron or hole, that contributes to current

examples.en: In the model, either a conduction electron or a hole can act as a charge carrier.
examples.zh: 在模型里，导带电子和空穴都可以充当「载流子」。

examples.en: The electric field changes the average drift velocity of each type of charge carrier in the sample.
examples.zh: 电场改变了样品中每类「载流子」的平均漂移速度。

words.enDefinition: an electron promoted to the conduction band and the associated vacancy left in the valence band

examples.en: Absorbing a photon generated an electron-hole pair in the semiconductor shown in the classroom animation.
examples.zh: 课堂动画中的半导体吸收一个光子后，产生了一个「电子空穴对」。

examples.en: The simulation shows one electron-hole pair disappearing when the electron recombines with a hole in the sample.
examples.zh: 模拟显示，样品中的电子与空穴复合时，一组「电子空穴对」消失。

words.enDefinition: the mobile charge carrier type with the higher concentration in a semiconductor region

examples.en: The electron is the majority carrier in the donor-doped region marked on the band diagram.
examples.zh: 在能带图标出的施主掺杂区域，电子是「多数载流子」。

examples.en: We identified the majority carrier by comparing the hole and electron concentrations in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们通过比较练习中的空穴和电子浓度，判断何者是「多数载流子」。

words.enDefinition: the mobile charge carrier type with the lower concentration in a semiconductor region

examples.en: The hole is the minority carrier on the donor-doped side of the junction in our model.
examples.zh: 在我们的结模型中，空穴是施主掺杂一侧的「少数载流子」。

examples.en: The simulated minority carrier concentration increased locally when light struck the sample during the demonstration.
examples.zh: 演示中，光照到样品时，模拟的「少数载流子」浓度在局部上升。

words.enDefinition: the interface between p-type and n-type regions in a semiconductor

examples.en: At equilibrium, a narrow region around the p-n junction contained few mobile charge carriers in the drawing.
examples.zh: 图示的平衡状态下，「PN 结」周围的一小块区域几乎没有可移动载流子。

examples.en: We reversed the voltage across the p-n junction in the simulation and compared its current readings.
examples.zh: 我们在模拟中反转「PN 结」两端的电压，并比较随之得到的电流读数。

words.enDefinition: the region near a semiconductor junction in which mobile carriers are greatly reduced, leaving fixed ionized impurities

examples.en: The depletion region widened in the plot when the reverse bias across the junction increased.
examples.zh: 结两端的反向偏置增大时，图中的「耗尽区」变宽。

examples.en: We drew fixed charges inside the depletion region to explain the electric field near the junction.
examples.zh: 我们在「耗尽区」内画出固定电荷，以说明结附近的电场。

collocations: electric field in the depletion region

words.enDefinition: a two-terminal device that typically conducts much more easily in one direction than the other

examples.en: The diode model predicted much greater current when the applied voltage had the forward polarity.
examples.zh: 「二极管」模型预测，外加电压为正向极性时电流会大得多。

examples.en: We plotted the diode current against voltage to compare the simulated forward and reverse behavior.
examples.zh: 我们绘出「二极管」的电流与电压关系，比较正向和反向的模拟特性。

words.enDefinition: an applied voltage that lowers a junction's potential barrier and favors the flow of forward current

examples.en: With forward bias, the simple silicon junction model predicted a narrower depletion region and greater current.
examples.zh: 施加「正向偏置」后，简化的硅结模型预测耗尽区变窄且电流增大。

examples.en: The instructor compared two forward bias voltages on the diode curve to illustrate its nonlinear response.
examples.zh: 老师比较了二极管曲线上的两个「正向偏置」电压，以说明其非线性响应。

collocations: operate a diode under forward bias

words.enDefinition: an applied voltage that raises a junction's potential barrier and normally limits current before breakdown

examples.en: In the simulation, reverse bias made the depletion region wider than it was at equilibrium.
examples.zh: 模拟中，「反向偏置」使耗尽区比平衡时更宽。

examples.en: The ideal model predicted zero current under reverse bias, while the measured current was small but detectable.
examples.zh: 理想模型预测「反向偏置」下的电流为零，实测电流虽小但可测得。

collocations: operate a diode under reverse bias

words.enDefinition: the small reverse current through a biased device before it reaches breakdown

examples.en: The recorded reverse leakage current remained small over the voltage range shown on the classroom graph.
examples.zh: 课堂图所示电压范围内，记录的「反向漏电流」一直很小。

examples.en: We compared the reverse leakage current at two temperatures using the component data provided in class.
examples.zh: 我们用课堂给出的元件数据比较两个温度下的「反向漏电流」。

collocations: reverse leakage current at room temperature

words.enDefinition: a graph showing the relation between the voltage across a diode and the current through it

examples.en: The diode characteristic curve rose steeply in the forward direction over the range shown in class.
examples.zh: 在课堂给定的范围内，「二极管特性曲线」沿正向陡升。

examples.en: We used the diode characteristic curve to find the current at a specified forward voltage.
examples.zh: 我们用「二极管特性曲线」找出指定正向电压下的电流。

words.enDefinition: the voltage across a forward-biased diode at a stated current and temperature

examples.en: The worksheet compares diode forward voltage at the same current for three different device samples.
examples.zh: 练习比较三个不同器件样品在相同电流下的「二极管正向压降」。

examples.en: Our model picked a fixed diode forward voltage as a simple approximation for the conducting state.
examples.zh: 模型选取固定的「二极管正向压降」，对导通状态作简单近似。

collocations: diode forward voltage at a specified current

words.enDefinition: a diode that emits light as electrons recombine with holes under forward operation

examples.en: The display lights up because each light-emitting diode converts part of its electrical input into visible light.
examples.zh: 显示屏会亮起，因为每个「发光二极管」都将一部分输入电能转化为可见光。

examples.en: The drawing uses arrows pointing out of the symbol to represent a light-emitting diode.
examples.zh: 图中用从符号向外的箭头来表示「发光二极管」。

words.enDefinition: a diode designed so that absorbed light generates a measurable current

examples.en: The simulated photodiode generated more current when the model increased the light reaching its active area.
examples.zh: 模型增大照到感光区的光量时，模拟「光电二极管」产生的电流也增大。

examples.en: We distinguished the photodiode from the display diode by the inward arrows on its symbol.
examples.zh: 我们通过符号上朝内的箭头，把「光电二极管」与显示用二极管区分开。

words.enDefinition: the additional electric current generated by a device in response to absorbed light

examples.en: In the provided readings, photocurrent increased as the light level rose above the dark reference.
examples.zh: 在给出的读数中，光照高于暗态基准后，「光电流」随光照增强而增大。

examples.en: We estimated photocurrent by subtracting the detector's dark reading from the reading taken under illumination.
examples.zh: 我们用光照下的读数减去探测器的暗态读数，估算「光电流」。

collocations: subtract the dark current to find photocurrent

words.enDefinition: conversion of an alternating signal into one with a single polarity or direction

examples.en: The two traces show rectification changing a symmetric input into a pulsating output of one polarity.
examples.zh: 两条曲线显示，「整流」将对称输入变成了单一极性的脉动输出。

examples.en: We described rectification and smoothing as separate stages when interpreting the simulated power supply waveforms.
examples.zh: 我们在解读模拟的电源波形时，将「整流」和平滑视为不同的阶段。

words.enDefinition: a rectifier that passes one polarity of the input waveform and blocks the other

examples.en: The ideal half-wave rectifier produced no output during the negative half of each input cycle.
examples.zh: 理想「半波整流器」在每个输入周期的负半周没有输出。

examples.en: We compared the positive pulses from the half-wave rectifier with the original sinusoidal input in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把「半波整流器」输出的正脉冲与原始的正弦输入作比较。

words.enDefinition: a rectifier that uses a bridge arrangement to send both input half cycles through a load in the same direction

examples.en: The full-wave bridge rectifier produced two positive output pulses per input cycle in our idealized simulation.
examples.zh: 在我们的理想化模拟中，「全波桥式整流器」每个输入周期产生两个正向输出脉冲。

examples.en: We traced the full-wave bridge rectifier paths to see why the load current kept the same direction.
examples.zh: 我们追踪「全波桥式整流器」的电流路径，了解负载电流为何方向不变。

words.enDefinition: the residual periodic voltage variation superimposed on the average output of a nominally direct-current supply

examples.en: A small ripple voltage remained visible above the nearly steady level on the simulated output trace.
examples.zh: 模拟输出曲线在近似恒定的电平附近仍可看到少量「纹波电压」。

examples.en: We compared ripple voltage by reading the separation between adjacent peaks and troughs on both traces.
examples.zh: 我们读取两条曲线中相邻波峰与波谷的差值，比较「纹波电压」。

words.enDefinition: a diode designed to operate in controlled reverse breakdown with a relatively stable voltage

examples.en: The simulated Zener diode maintained nearly the same reverse voltage over the chosen range of current.
examples.zh: 在所选电流范围内，模拟的「齐纳二极管」两端的反向电压几乎不变。

examples.en: We located the breakdown region of the Zener diode on the supplied current versus voltage graph.
examples.zh: 我们在给出的电流电压图中找出了「齐纳二极管」的击穿区域。

words.enDefinition: a semiconductor device in which one electrical input controls current in another part of the device

examples.en: The circuit uses a transistor to control the lamp current with a separate low-power input.
examples.zh: 电路用「晶体管」通过独立的低功率输入控制灯的电流。

examples.en: We modeled the transistor as a switch in one exercise and as an amplifier in another.
examples.zh: 我们在一道题中把「晶体管」建模为开关，在另一道题中建模为放大器。

words.enDefinition: a three-terminal semiconductor device in which both electrons and holes participate, with emitter, base and collector terminals

examples.en: The diagram labels the three terminals of the bipolar junction transistor before showing its current directions.
examples.zh: 图中先标出「双极结型晶体管」的三个端子，再显示电流方向。

examples.en: Our bipolar junction transistor model linked a small base current to a larger change in collector current.
examples.zh: 我们的「双极结型晶体管」模型将较小的基极电流变化与较大的集电极电流变化联系起来。

words.enDefinition: current through the base terminal of a bipolar junction transistor

examples.en: The model changed the base current and recorded how much the collector current changed with it.
examples.zh: 模型改变「基极电流」，并记录集电极电流随之改变多少。

examples.en: We calculated base current from the simulation trace and compared it with the emitter current.
examples.zh: 我们根据模拟曲线算出「基极电流」，再与发射极电流比较。

words.enDefinition: current through the collector terminal of a bipolar junction transistor

examples.en: The collector current varied little with collector voltage in the forward-active region at fixed base current.
examples.zh: 在基极电流固定的正向有源区，「集电极电流」随集电极电压的变化很小。

examples.en: We read the collector current at the marked bias point on the transistor characteristic curves.
examples.zh: 我们在晶体管特性曲线上读出标定偏置点处的「集电极电流」。

collocations: collector current at the bias point

words.enDefinition: current through the emitter terminal of a bipolar junction transistor

examples.en: The calculated emitter current equaled the sum of the base and collector current magnitudes under our sign convention.
examples.zh: 按本题的符号约定，算得的「发射极电流」等于基极电流与集电极电流的大小之和。

examples.en: We checked the emitter current in the circuit table after labeling all three reference directions.
examples.zh: 我们标出三个电流的参考方向之后，核对了电路表中的「发射极电流」。

collocations: emitter current in a bipolar transistor

words.enDefinition: the ratio of an output current, or its change, to the corresponding input current or change

examples.en: We estimated the current gain from the change in collector current divided by the base current change.
examples.zh: 我们用集电极电流的变化量除以基极电流的变化量，估算「电流增益」。

examples.en: The graph shows that current gain depends on the operating point chosen for the small-signal analysis.
examples.zh: 图中显示，「电流增益」取决于小信号分析所选择的工作点。

words.enDefinition: a transistor in which an electric field from a gate controls current through a channel

examples.en: The field-effect transistor model showed the channel current changing as the gate voltage was varied.
examples.zh: 「场效应晶体管」模型显示，沟道电流随栅极电压改变。

examples.en: We compared the field-effect transistor symbol with the bipolar transistor symbol in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图中比较了「场效应晶体管」和双极型晶体管的符号。

words.zhGloss: 金属氧化物半导体场效应晶体管
words.enDefinition: a type of field-effect transistor with an oxide or other insulating layer separating its gate from the channel
acceptedZhAnswers: 金属氧化物半导体场效应晶体管

examples.en: The model uses a MOSFET to show how an insulated gate controls the current through a channel.
examples.zh: 模型用「金属氧化物半导体场效应晶体管」展示绝缘栅极怎样控制通过沟道的电流。

examples.en: The gate terminal of the ideal MOSFET drew no steady current in the circuit simulation.
examples.zh: 在电路模拟中，理想的「金属氧化物半导体场效应晶体管」栅极端不吸收稳态电流。

words.enDefinition: the connection through which voltage controls a field-effect transistor's channel

examples.en: We highlighted the gate terminal on each symbol before comparing how the two transistor circuits respond.
examples.zh: 我们先在每个符号上突出「栅极端」，再比较两种晶体管电路的响应。

examples.en: The input voltage in the sketch is applied to the gate terminal relative to the source.
examples.zh: 示意图中的输入电压以源极为参考，施加在「栅极端」。

collocations: apply voltage to the gate terminal

words.enDefinition: the transistor connection at one end of the channel, conventionally named in relation to the source

examples.en: The drain terminal connects to the load resistor in the amplifier schematic used by the instructor.
examples.zh: 老师所用的放大器电路图中，「漏极端」与负载电阻相连。

examples.en: We read the current entering the drain terminal from the marked trace in the simulation.
examples.zh: 我们从模拟中有标记的曲线读出流入「漏极端」的电流。

collocations: measure voltage at the drain terminal

words.enDefinition: the field-effect transistor connection from which carriers are supplied to the channel in normal operation

examples.en: The example measures the gate potential relative to the source terminal rather than relative to ground.
examples.zh: 示例中的栅极电位以「源极端」为基准，地并非这里的基准。

examples.en: The source terminal of the transistor was connected to the common reference in our classroom schematic.
examples.zh: 课堂电路图中，晶体管的「源极端」连接到公共参考点。

collocations: measure voltage at the source terminal
connect a resistor to the source terminal

words.enDefinition: the electric potential of a field-effect transistor's gate relative to its source

examples.en: We calculated gate-source voltage by subtracting the source potential from the gate potential in the table.
examples.zh: 我们用表中的栅极电位减去源极电位，算出「栅源电压」。

examples.en: The simulated transistor's drain current increased as its gate-source voltage rose above the threshold in our model.
examples.zh: 模型中，模拟晶体管的「栅源电压」超过阈值后继续升高，漏极电流也随之增大。

words.enDefinition: in a MOSFET model, the gate-source voltage at which a conducting inversion channel begins to form

examples.en: The ideal model marks threshold voltage where an inversion channel first appears under the gate oxide.
examples.zh: 理想模型在栅氧化层下首次出现反型沟道的位置标出「阈值电压」。

examples.en: We compared the device's threshold voltage with the gate-source voltage stated in the simulated switching example.
examples.zh: 我们把器件的「阈值电压」与模拟开关示例中给出的栅源电压作比较。

words.enDefinition: in an enhancement-mode MOSFET, the creation of a conducting inversion layer between source and drain by the gate field

examples.en: The band sketch associates channel formation with the appearance of an inversion layer below the gate.
examples.zh: 能带示意图把「沟道形成」与栅下反型层的出现联系起来。

examples.en: We used a sequence of carrier density plots to illustrate channel formation in the transistor model.
examples.zh: 我们用一系列载流子密度图展示晶体管模型中的「沟道形成」。

words.enDefinition: the region in which gate-to-source drive is insufficient to turn the MOSFET on, so its ideal drain current is zero

examples.en: The cutoff region of a MOSFET appears where our simplified model approximates the drain current as zero.
examples.zh: 简化模型把漏极电流近似为零时，对应「MOSFET 截止区」。

examples.en: We identified the cutoff region of a MOSFET before drawing its modeled switch state in the truth table.
examples.zh: 我们先判断是否在「MOSFET 截止区」，再在真值表中画出模型对应的开关状态。

collocations: identify the cutoff region of a MOSFET
model the cutoff region of a MOSFET
inspect the cutoff region of a MOSFET

words.enDefinition: the conducting region in the long-channel model where the drain-source voltage magnitude is below the gate overdrive

examples.en: At sufficient gate drive, low drain-source voltages fell within the triode region of a MOSFET in simulation.
examples.zh: 在栅极驱动足够的模拟中，较低的漏源电压对应「MOSFET 线性区」。

examples.en: Our tutor likened the triode region of a MOSFET to a gate-controlled resistance near zero drain-source voltage.
examples.zh: 老师用栅极控制的电阻，类比漏源电压接近零时的「MOSFET 线性区」。

collocations: identify the triode region of a MOSFET
model the triode region of a MOSFET
examine the triode region of a MOSFET

words.enDefinition: the conducting region where drain current is governed primarily by gate-source voltage and depends relatively weakly on drain-source voltage

examples.en: The modeled curve flattened as it entered the saturation region of a MOSFET for the selected gate voltage.
examples.zh: 给定栅极电压时，模型曲线进入「MOSFET 饱和区」后变平。

examples.en: The instructor chose the saturation region of a MOSFET to introduce small variations around an amplifier operating point.
examples.zh: 老师选择在「MOSFET 饱和区」介绍放大器工作点附近的小变化。

collocations: identify the saturation region of a MOSFET
model the saturation region of a MOSFET
bias into the saturation region of a MOSFET

words.enDefinition: a field-effect transistor amplifier with input at the gate, output at the drain and source as the common reference

examples.en: The output of the unloaded common-source amplifier fell when the simulated gate voltage rose slightly.
examples.zh: 模拟栅极电压略微升高时，空载「共源极放大器」的输出下降。

examples.en: We identified the shared source node before explaining the name of the common-source amplifier in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先找出公共源极节点，再解释「共源极放大器」这一名称。

collocations: small-signal model of a common-source amplifier

words.enDefinition: a linear approximation describing a nonlinear device's response to small changes around a chosen operating point

examples.en: The small-signal model matched the simulated gain closely only for inputs near the chosen bias point.
examples.zh: 只有输入接近所选偏置点时，「小信号模型」才与模拟增益十分接近。

examples.en: We replaced the nonlinear device equation with a small-signal model to estimate the slope near equilibrium.
examples.zh: 我们用「小信号模型」代替非线性器件方程，以估计平衡点附近的斜率。

words.enDefinition: the steady operating values of current and voltage that are set before variations due to a signal

examples.en: The bias point appears at the intersection of the device curve and the load line in class.
examples.zh: 在课堂上，「偏置点」标在器件曲线与负载线的交点。

examples.en: We checked where the bias point lay before applying the linear approximation to the amplifier model.
examples.zh: 我们先确认「偏置点」的位置，再对放大器模型应用线性近似。

words.enDefinition: the change in output current per unit change in input voltage near a specified operating point

examples.en: We estimated transconductance from the slope of drain current against gate voltage at fixed drain-source voltage.
examples.zh: 在漏源电压固定时，我们用漏极电流随栅极电压变化的曲线斜率估算「跨导」。

examples.en: The simulator reported transconductance in siemens because it measured current change per unit of voltage change.
examples.zh: 模拟器用西门子报告「跨导」，因为它衡量的是每单位电压变化引起的电流变化。

words.enDefinition: the ratio of output voltage variation to input voltage variation, expressed as a complex ratio for sinusoidal steady state

examples.en: The voltage gain was negative because the output fell when the input rose in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中输入升高时输出下降，所以「电压增益」为负。

examples.en: We compared voltage gain at two frequencies using the amplitude ratio shown in the simulation table.
examples.zh: 我们用模拟表中的振幅比，比较两个频率下的「电压增益」大小。

words.enDefinition: a high-gain differential amplifier with an inverting input and a noninverting input

examples.en: The operational amplifier in the diagram responds to the voltage difference between its two input terminals.
examples.zh: 图中的「运算放大器」响应两个输入端子之间的电压差。

examples.en: We examined how feedback let the same operational amplifier perform several different operations in the simulator.
examples.zh: 我们探究反馈怎样让同一「运算放大器」在模拟器中实现几种不同运算。

words.enDefinition: the terminal of a differential amplifier at which a higher voltage tends to lower the output

examples.en: The inverting input is labeled with a minus sign on the operational amplifier symbol in our notes.
examples.zh: 笔记里，运算放大器符号上的减号标记的是「反相输入端」。

examples.en: We increased the voltage at the inverting input and watched the open-loop output decrease in the simulation.
examples.zh: 我们提高「反相输入端」电压，在模拟中看到开环输出下降。

collocations: apply a signal to the inverting input

words.enDefinition: the terminal of a differential amplifier at which a higher voltage tends to raise the output

examples.en: The noninverting input is the one marked by a plus sign on the classroom circuit diagram.
examples.zh: 在课堂电路图上，用加号标记的是「同相输入端」。

examples.en: Our simulation raised the noninverting input voltage slightly while keeping the inverting input voltage constant.
examples.zh: 我们在模拟中略微升高「同相输入端」电压，同时保持反相输入端电压恒定。

collocations: apply a signal to the noninverting input

words.enDefinition: the voltage at the noninverting input minus that at the inverting input of a differential amplifier

examples.en: We calculated differential input voltage by subtracting the inverting input potential from the noninverting input potential.
examples.zh: 我们用同相输入端的电位减去反相输入端的电位，计算「差分输入电压」。

examples.en: The differential input voltage stayed close to zero during normal linear operation in the feedback example.
examples.zh: 在反馈示例中，正常线性工作时，「差分输入电压」保持接近零。

words.enDefinition: the forward amplification of a system or stage when its external feedback path is disconnected

examples.en: The datasheet listed a very large open-loop gain for the operational amplifier at low frequency.
examples.zh: 数据手册列出了该运算放大器在低频下极大的「开环增益」。

examples.en: We compared open-loop gain with the smaller gain obtained after feedback was applied in the model.
examples.zh: 我们把「开环增益」与模型接入反馈后得到的较小增益作比较。

words.enDefinition: the ratio of output to input for a system operating with its feedback path connected

examples.en: We measured closed-loop gain after the output signal was fed back through the resistor network.
examples.zh: 输出信号经电阻网络返回后，我们测量了「闭环增益」。

examples.en: The closed-loop gain stayed nearly constant when the model varied the amplifier's internal gain slightly.
examples.zh: 模型略微改变放大器的内部增益时，「闭环增益」几乎保持不变。

words.enDefinition: a node held near the reference ground potential by feedback without a direct physical connection to ground

examples.en: The virtual ground stayed near zero volts in our amplifier model while the input signal changed.
examples.zh: 在放大器模型中，输入信号变化时，「虚地」仍保持接近零伏。

examples.en: We distinguished virtual ground from the grounded terminal by tracing the connections on the schematic.
examples.zh: 我们沿电路图追查连线，区分「虚地」和实际接地的端子。

words.enDefinition: an amplifier configuration whose output approximately equals the input voltage, usually used for buffering

examples.en: The voltage follower kept the output near the input value while driving the load in the simulator.
examples.zh: 在模拟器中，「电压跟随器」在驱动负载的同时使输出接近输入值。

examples.en: We used the voltage follower model to separate the sensor from the loading of the next stage.
examples.zh: 我们用「电压跟随器」模型将传感器与后一级的负载作用隔开。

words.enDefinition: an amplifier configuration whose output varies in the opposite direction to its applied input signal

examples.en: The simulated inverting amplifier produced a positive output swing in response to a negative input swing.
examples.zh: 模拟的「反相放大器」对负向输入变化给出正向输出变化。

examples.en: We read the inverting amplifier gain from the downward slope of the output versus input plot.
examples.zh: 我们用输出对输入图像向下的斜率读出「反相放大器」的增益。

words.enDefinition: an amplifier configuration whose output varies in the same direction as its applied input signal

examples.en: The noninverting amplifier traces show the input and output waveforms reaching their peaks at the same times.
examples.zh: 「同相放大器」的曲线显示，输入和输出波形在相同时刻达到各自峰值。

examples.en: We identified the noninverting amplifier from its positive gain and the negative feedback shown in the diagram.
examples.zh: 根据正增益和图中显示的负反馈，我们辨认出了「同相放大器」。

words.enDefinition: an amplifier circuit producing an output proportional to a weighted sum of several input signals

examples.en: The summing amplifier model gave each input a different weight by using different input resistor values.
examples.zh: 「求和放大器」模型用不同的输入电阻值给各输入分配不同权重。

examples.en: In the simulation, the summing amplifier combined two waveforms into a single output trace.
examples.zh: 在模拟中，「求和放大器」将两路波形合成为一条输出曲线。

words.enDefinition: the state in which a device output reaches a limit and cannot follow a further increase in demanded output

examples.en: The flat peaks in the graph marked output saturation near the model's positive and negative output limits.
examples.zh: 图中平顶部分标出靠近模型正负输出极限时的「输出饱和」。

examples.en: We reduced the simulated input and watched the output waveform recover from output saturation.
examples.zh: 我们减小模拟输入，观察输出波形从「输出饱和」状态恢复。

words.enDefinition: the maximum rate at which an amplifier's output voltage can change, commonly given in volts per microsecond

examples.en: The output edge was a ramp because the circuit model included a finite slew rate.
examples.zh: 电路模型设定了有限的「转换速率」，所以输出边沿是一段斜坡。

examples.en: We estimated the slew rate from the steepest part of the output voltage trace in simulation.
examples.zh: 我们用模拟输出电压曲线中最陡的一段估算「转换速率」。

words.enDefinition: a circuit with output states that indicate which of two input voltages is greater

examples.en: The comparator switched its output state whenever the sensor signal crossed the fixed reference voltage in simulation.
examples.zh: 模拟中，传感器信号每次跨越固定参考电压，「比较器」的输出状态就切换。

examples.en: We plotted both input voltages to see why the comparator output remained low between the two crossings.
examples.zh: 我们绘出两个输入电压，理解「比较器」输出为何在两次交越之间保持低电平。

words.enDefinition: a switching circuit that uses different input thresholds for transitions in opposite directions

examples.en: The Schmitt trigger changed state at different input levels on the rising and falling portions of the trace.
examples.zh: 在曲线上升段和下降段，「施密特触发器」在不同的输入电平切换状态。

examples.en: The Schmitt trigger model prevented small input fluctuations from causing repeated switches near the nominal threshold.
examples.zh: 「施密特触发器」模型避免了输入在标称阈值附近小幅波动时反复切换。

words.enDefinition: the range between the two input thresholds at which a switching circuit changes state in opposite directions

examples.en: The hysteresis band was the horizontal distance between the two switching thresholds on the transfer plot.
examples.zh: 传输特性图上，两个切换阈值之间的水平距离就是「滞回带」宽度。

examples.en: The simulated output held its previous state while the input remained inside the hysteresis band.
examples.zh: 只要输入保持在「滞回带」内，模拟输出就维持原状态。

words.enDefinition: a signal defined at every instant over a continuous time interval

examples.en: The continuous-time signal describes the modeled microphone voltage at any instant within the plotted interval.
examples.zh: 「连续时间信号」描述所绘时段内任一时刻的模拟传声器电压。

examples.en: We drew a curve for the continuous-time signal before marking the separate sampling instants on it.
examples.zh: 我们先画「连续时间信号」曲线，再在曲线上标出各个采样时刻。

words.enDefinition: a sequence of signal values indexed by separate time instants, regardless of whether its amplitudes are quantized

examples.en: The technician plotted the discrete-time signal as stems at the recorded sample numbers in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，技术员在记录的各采样编号处画出竖线，表示「离散时间信号」。

examples.en: The simulated discrete-time signal used exact real amplitudes even though each value had an integer index.
examples.zh: 模拟的「离散时间信号」为每个值赋予整数索引，幅值仍可取精确实数。

words.enDefinition: a signal represented by a physical quantity that can vary continuously in amplitude

examples.en: The sensor produces an analog signal whose voltage varies smoothly as the lamp grows brighter.
examples.zh: 灯变亮时，传感器产生的「模拟信号」电压平滑变化。

examples.en: We compared the analog signal from the microphone with the sequence of codes recorded by the converter.
examples.zh: 我们把传声器发出的「模拟信号」与转换器记录的编码序列比较。

words.enDefinition: a signal using a discrete set of values or symbols to represent information

examples.en: The digital signal uses two nominal levels to represent the recorded bits on the classroom trace.
examples.zh: 课堂曲线上的「数字信号」用两个标称电平表示记录的比特。

examples.en: We decoded the digital signal after assigning each sampled level to one of the two symbols.
examples.zh: 我们先将每个采样电平归入两个符号中的一个，再对「数字信号」解码。

words.enDefinition: a description of how the values of a signal vary with time

examples.en: The time-domain representation revealed a brief pulse immediately after the second click in the recording.
examples.zh: 「时域表示」显示，录音中的第二次咔嗒声后立即出现一个短脉冲。

examples.en: We used the time-domain representation to compare the order in which the two pulses arrived.
examples.zh: 我们用「时域表示」比较两个脉冲到达的先后顺序。

words.enDefinition: a description of a signal in terms of the amplitudes and phases of its frequency components

examples.en: The frequency-domain representation showed two prominent components in the recorded note from the instrument.
examples.zh: 「频域表示」显示，录下的乐器音符包含两个显著的频率成分。

examples.en: We compared the frequency-domain representation before and after filtering to see which components were reduced.
examples.zh: 我们比较滤波前后的「频域表示」，检查哪些成分变弱。

words.enDefinition: a signal equal to zero before a chosen instant and one after it, with the value at the instant set by convention

examples.en: The simulation uses a unit step signal to represent a command that changes abruptly and stays fixed.
examples.zh: 模拟用「单位阶跃信号」表示突然改变后保持不变的指令。

examples.en: We shifted the unit step signal in time to place its transition at the marked instant.
examples.zh: 我们将「单位阶跃信号」沿时间轴平移，使它在标记时刻跳变。

collocations: response to a unit step signal

words.enDefinition: an ideal signal concentrated at time zero, with unit integral in continuous time or unit value at index zero in discrete time

examples.en: The symbol for the unit impulse signal uses an arrow because an ordinary height would be misleading.
examples.zh: 「单位冲激信号」的符号使用箭头，因为连续时间冲激需要用面积刻画。

examples.en: For the discrete unit impulse signal, only the sample at index zero equals one in our table.
examples.zh: 对于表中的离散「单位冲激信号」，只有索引为零的样本等于一。

collocations: response to a unit impulse signal

words.enDefinition: a system satisfying superposition whose response to a delayed input is the same response delayed by that amount

examples.en: A linear time-invariant system produced the same waveform later when we delayed the input in simulation.
examples.zh: 在模拟中延迟输入后，「线性时不变系统」以同样的延迟输出了相同波形。

examples.en: We checked superposition and time-shift behavior before treating the model as a linear time-invariant system in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先检查叠加和时移特性，再把模型看作「线性时不变系统」。

collocations: response of a linear time-invariant system

words.enDefinition: the output of a system initially at rest when the input is a unit impulse

examples.en: We obtained the impulse response by applying a single unit sample to the discrete filter model.
examples.zh: 我们向离散滤波器模型施加一个单位样本，得到「冲激响应」。

examples.en: The first few values of the impulse response showed how long the filter retained the input's effect.
examples.zh: 「冲激响应」的前几个值显示出滤波器保留输入影响的时长。

words.enDefinition: the discrete-time convolution of two sequences at a given index, summing pairwise products over all indices whose sum equals that index

examples.en: We used the convolution sum to predict the sampled filter output from the input and impulse response.
examples.zh: 我们用「卷积和」根据输入与冲激响应预测采样滤波器的输出。

examples.en: The first output in the convolution sum involved only one overlap between the two finite sequences.
examples.zh: 在「卷积和」的第一个输出位置，两个有限序列只有一处重叠。

words.enDefinition: the integral of one function at a running time multiplied by a second function at the output time minus that running time

examples.en: We evaluated the convolution integral by finding where the shifted pulse overlapped the nonzero input interval.
examples.zh: 我们找出平移后的脉冲与输入非零区间的重叠范围，计算「卷积积分」。

examples.en: The model took the convolution integral of the input and impulse response to predict the continuous output.
examples.zh: 模型对输入和冲激响应求「卷积积分」，预测连续输出。

collocations: determine the limits of a convolution integral

words.enDefinition: for a linear time-invariant system, the ratio of transformed output to transformed input with zero initial conditions

examples.en: The transfer function relates the transformed output to the transformed input when stored energy starts at zero.
examples.zh: 初始储能为零时，「传递函数」联系变换后的输出与变换后的输入。

examples.en: We compared the poles of the transfer function with the decay rates seen in the simulation.
examples.zh: 我们把「传递函数」的极点与模拟中观察到的衰减速率作比较。

words.enDefinition: the complex gain of a linear time-invariant system for steady sinusoidal inputs at frequencies where it is defined

examples.en: The frequency response showed that the filter attenuated the faster oscillation more strongly than the slower one.
examples.zh: 「频率响应」表明，滤波器对较快振荡的衰减强于对较慢振荡的衰减。

examples.en: We recorded the amplitude ratio and phase difference at several frequencies to plot the frequency response.
examples.zh: 我们记录多个频率下的振幅比和相位差，用来画「频率响应」。

words.enDefinition: the magnitude of a system's frequency response, giving the amplitude ratio at each frequency

examples.en: The magnitude response stayed close to one for low-frequency inputs in the idealized filter model.
examples.zh: 在理想化滤波器模型中，低频输入对应的「幅频响应」接近一。

examples.en: We read the magnitude response first to determine which of the two tones would be weaker.
examples.zh: 为判断哪种音调会变得更弱，我们先读取「幅频响应」。

words.enDefinition: the phase of a system's frequency response, giving the output phase relative to the input at each frequency

examples.en: The phase response showed a growing lag as we tested higher frequencies in the simulation.
examples.zh: 在模拟中测试越来越高的频率时，「相频响应」显示相位滞后逐渐增大。

examples.en: Two filters had equal amplitude ratios at one frequency, but their phase response curves were different.
examples.zh: 两种滤波器在某个频率下的振幅比相同，但「相频响应」曲线不同。

words.enDefinition: the frequency range over which a filter is intended to pass signals within a specified gain tolerance

examples.en: The two low notes lay inside the passband and remained clear in the filtered audio example.
examples.zh: 两个低音落在「通带」内，在经过滤波的音频示例中依旧清楚。

examples.en: We marked the passband where the plotted gain stayed inside the tolerance drawn on the graph.
examples.zh: 我们将图中增益始终处于标定容差内的范围标为「通带」。

words.enDefinition: the frequency range over which a filter is intended to attenuate signals by at least a specified amount

examples.en: The high tone fell in the stopband and became faint when we applied the simulated filter.
examples.zh: 高音落在「阻带」内，经过模拟滤波后变得微弱。

examples.en: The worksheet used a shaded region to show where the filter met the required stopband attenuation.
examples.zh: 练习用阴影标出滤波器满足「阻带」衰减要求的区域。

words.enDefinition: the frequency interval between the edge of a filter's passband and the edge of its adjacent stopband

examples.en: The filter's transition band was visible where the gain fell between the two tolerance regions.
examples.zh: 在两个容差区之间增益下降的区域，可看到滤波器的「过渡带」。

examples.en: We compared the width of the transition band on two simulated low-pass filter plots in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们比较了两张低通滤波器模拟图中「过渡带」的宽度。

words.enDefinition: a frequency marking a filter or system's chosen response boundary, often defined by a specified gain reduction

examples.en: We located the cutoff frequency at the marked gain reduction on the frequency response plot.
examples.zh: 我们在频率响应曲线上找到标定的增益下降量，对应该处的「截止频率」。

examples.en: Raising the cutoff frequency allowed more high-frequency content through the low-pass filter in our simulation.
examples.zh: 在模拟中，提高「截止频率」让低通滤波器通过了更多高频成分。

words.enDefinition: a filter passing frequencies below a chosen band edge while attenuating higher frequencies

examples.en: The low-pass filter removed much of the rapid fluctuation from the simulated temperature signal in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，「低通滤波器」减少了模拟温度信号中大部分的快速波动。

examples.en: We compared audio before and after the low-pass filter reduced the brighter high-frequency components of the sound.
examples.zh: 「低通滤波器」减弱了声音中较明亮的高频成分，我们比较了滤波前后的音频。

words.enDefinition: a filter passing frequencies above a chosen band edge while attenuating lower frequencies

examples.en: The high-pass filter reduced a slow baseline drift while retaining the faster features in the example waveform.
examples.zh: 「高通滤波器」减弱了示例波形中缓慢的基线漂移，保留了变化较快的特征。

examples.en: We used the high-pass filter to remove the constant offset from the simulated signal shown in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用「高通滤波器」从模拟信号中去除恒定偏移。

words.enDefinition: a filter passing a bounded range of frequencies while attenuating frequencies below and above that range

examples.en: The band-pass filter retained the middle tone while weakening both the lowest and highest tones in the mixture.
examples.zh: 「带通滤波器」保留了混合声音的中间音调，减弱了最低和最高音调。

examples.en: We marked the two edges of the band-pass filter on the plotted magnitude response in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在幅频响应图上标出「带通滤波器」的两个边界频率。

words.enDefinition: a filter that attenuates a selected frequency band while passing frequencies above and below it

examples.en: The band-stop filter reduced one band of audible interference while preserving tones on either side in simulation.
examples.zh: 在模拟中，「带阻滤波器」减弱了一段频带内的可闻干扰，保留了两侧频率的音调。

examples.en: We checked whether the noisy tone fell between the band-stop filter edges marked on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们检查干扰音是否落在练习表上标出的「带阻滤波器」两个边界频率之间。

words.enDefinition: a signal whose frequency spectrum is zero outside a bounded frequency range

examples.en: The instructor modeled the example as a bandlimited signal with no components above the stated upper frequency.
examples.zh: 老师把示例建模为「带限信号」，在给定频率上限之上没有分量。

examples.en: We used a bandlimited signal to show when samples can describe a continuous waveform exactly in theory.
examples.zh: 我们用「带限信号」说明什么条件下采样值在理论上可以精确表示连续波形。

words.enDefinition: an expansion of a periodic function in sines and cosines, or complex exponentials, at harmonically related frequencies

examples.en: The Fourier series represented the classroom waveform using a fundamental component and a sequence of harmonics.
examples.zh: 「傅里叶级数」用基波分量和一系列谐波表示课堂波形。

examples.en: We plotted the first three terms of the Fourier series to see how they approximated the periodic signal.
examples.zh: 我们画出「傅里叶级数」的前三项，看它们如何近似周期信号。

words.enDefinition: a mathematical transformation describing a function by the amplitudes and phases of its constituent frequencies

examples.en: The Fourier transform revealed a continuous spread of frequencies for the short pulse in our example.
examples.zh: 「傅里叶变换」显示，示例中的短脉冲含有连续分布的频率成分。

examples.en: We compared each waveform with its Fourier transform to see how changing pulse width affected the spectrum.
examples.zh: 我们将各波形与其「傅里叶变换」比较，考察脉宽如何影响频谱。

words.enDefinition: a transformation taking a finite sequence to complex coefficients on an equally spaced frequency grid of the same size

examples.en: We used the discrete Fourier transform to identify the largest frequency coefficient in the sampled recording.
examples.zh: 我们用「离散傅里叶变换」找出采样记录中最大的频率系数。

examples.en: At fixed sampling frequency, collecting more samples narrowed the frequency spacing of the discrete Fourier transform.
examples.zh: 采样频率固定时，采集更多样本使「离散傅里叶变换」的频率间距缩小。

words.enDefinition: a contribution to a signal associated with a particular frequency or narrow frequency range

examples.en: The largest spectral component in our recording matched the tuning fork's nominal frequency printed on its handle.
examples.zh: 录音中最大的「频谱分量」与音叉柄上印的标称频率一致。

examples.en: We traced the unexpected spectral component to a second tone included in the simulated recording.
examples.zh: 我们发现，意外出现的「频谱分量」来自模拟录音中加入的第二个音调。

words.enDefinition: a spectrum consisting of contributions at isolated frequencies, as for an ideal periodic signal

examples.en: The line spectrum had marks only at the fundamental and several of its multiples in the sketch.
examples.zh: 示意图中的「线状频谱」只在基频及其若干整数倍处有标记。

examples.en: We drew the line spectrum after calculating the nonzero Fourier series coefficients for the repeated waveform.
examples.zh: 我们算出重复波形的非零傅里叶级数系数后，画出「线状频谱」。

collocations: line spectrum of a periodic signal

words.enDefinition: the number of equally spaced samples taken per unit time

examples.en: We doubled the sampling frequency and obtained twice as many readings during the same recorded interval.
examples.zh: 我们将「采样频率」翻倍，在同一段记录时间内取得了两倍的读数。

examples.en: The report gives the sampling frequency in hertz beside the description of the acquisition setup.
examples.zh: 报告在说明采集装置的同时，以赫兹列出「采样频率」。

words.enDefinition: the time interval between successive samples in uniform sampling

examples.en: The sampling period was shorter when the system recorded more values in the same observation window.
examples.zh: 系统在同一观测时段内记录更多数值时，「采样周期」更短。

examples.en: We found the sampling period by taking the reciprocal of the sampling frequency on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们取练习中采样频率的倒数，求出「采样周期」。

words.enDefinition: twice the highest frequency in a baseband signal, the threshold a uniform sampling rate should exceed for ideal reconstruction

examples.en: We compared the actual sampling frequency with the Nyquist rate calculated from the example's highest frequency.
examples.zh: 我们把实际采样频率与根据示例最高频率计算出的「奈奎斯特采样率」作比较。

examples.en: The Nyquist rate doubled because the highest frequency in the modeled input signal also doubled.
examples.zh: 模型输入信号的最高频率翻倍后，「奈奎斯特采样率」也翻倍。

words.enDefinition: one half of the sampling frequency, marking the upper edge of the baseband for uniformly sampled data

examples.en: On the sampled spectrum, we marked the Nyquist frequency at half the recorder's sampling frequency.
examples.zh: 在采样信号的频谱图上，我们在记录器采样频率的一半处标出「奈奎斯特频率」。

examples.en: The tone was above the Nyquist frequency, so its sampled representation overlapped a lower frequency in the model.
examples.zh: 音调高于「奈奎斯特频率」，因此在模型中，采样后的表现与一个较低频率重合。

words.enDefinition: the loss of frequency distinguishability when different continuous signals give the same uniformly spaced samples

examples.en: The simulation showed aliasing when a high-frequency tone appeared at a lower frequency in the sampled data.
examples.zh: 高频音调以较低频率出现在采样数据中时，模拟展示了「混叠」。

examples.en: We increased the sampling frequency and watched the spurious component from aliasing disappear in the reconstructed waveform.
examples.zh: 我们提高采样频率，看到重构波形中因「混叠」产生的伪分量消失。

words.enDefinition: a filter applied before sampling to suppress components that would overlap frequencies of interest after sampling

examples.en: The anti-aliasing filter reduced the high-frequency components before the converter sampled the simulated microphone signal.
examples.zh: 转换器对模拟传声器信号采样之前，「抗混叠滤波器」减弱了高频分量。

examples.en: We compared spectra from two simulated converters, one with an anti-aliasing filter and one with unfiltered input.
examples.zh: 我们比较两个模拟转换器的频谱，一个使用「抗混叠滤波器」，另一个使用未滤波的输入。

words.enDefinition: a circuit that captures an input value at a sampling instant and holds it for a subsequent interval

examples.en: The sample-and-hold circuit kept the input value constant during conversion in the classroom block diagram.
examples.zh: 在课堂方框图里，「采样保持电路」在转换期间保持输入值恒定。

examples.en: We drew the sample-and-hold circuit output as a series of levels that change at each sampling instant.
examples.zh: 我们将「采样保持电路」的输出画成一系列在各采样时刻改变的电平。

words.enDefinition: the process of estimating or recovering a continuous-time signal from its samples

examples.en: The example uses signal reconstruction to turn the stored sample values back into a continuous waveform.
examples.zh: 示例用「信号重构」把存储的采样值重新转成连续波形。

examples.en: We compared signal reconstruction with linear interpolation against the ideal result for the bandlimited example.
examples.zh: 我们把线性插值所得的「信号重构」结果与带限示例的理想结果比较。

words.enDefinition: a device that represents an analog input with a sequence of numerical codes

examples.en: The analog-to-digital converter produced one code for each sample of the sensor voltage in the simulation.
examples.zh: 在模拟中，「模数转换器」为传感器电压的每个采样值生成一个编码。

examples.en: We compared the analog-to-digital converter outputs for two input voltages that fell inside the same code interval.
examples.zh: 我们比较两个落在同一编码区间的输入电压对应的「模数转换器」输出。

words.enDefinition: a device that converts a digital code to a corresponding analog output level or waveform

examples.en: The digital-to-analog converter produced a stepped voltage trace as we supplied a sequence of increasing codes.
examples.zh: 我们输入递增的编码序列时，「数模转换器」产生阶梯形电压曲线。

examples.en: We compared the digital-to-analog converter output with the continuous reference curve in the audio demonstration.
examples.zh: 我们在音频演示中比较「数模转换器」输出与连续参考曲线。

words.enDefinition: the mapping of continuous or finely spaced amplitudes to a finite or countable set of discrete levels

examples.en: The rounded steps on the plot illustrate quantization of the simulated sensor's smoothly varying input voltage.
examples.zh: 图中取近似值形成的阶梯展示了如何对模拟传感器的连续变化输入电压进行「量化」。

examples.en: Because of quantization, two slightly different input voltages produced the same digital code in our example.
examples.zh: 由于存在「量化」，示例中两个略有不同的输入电压生成了相同的数字编码。

words.enDefinition: the spacing between adjacent representable amplitude levels in a uniform quantizer

examples.en: We identified the quantization step as the height difference between adjacent levels on the transfer plot.
examples.zh: 我们将传输图上相邻电平的高度之差认作「量化步长」。

examples.en: Reducing the quantization step produced smaller changes between the levels of the simulated converter output.
examples.zh: 减小「量化步长」后，模拟转换器输出的相邻电平差变小。

words.enDefinition: the difference between a quantized value and the original input value

examples.en: With rounding to the nearest level, quantization error changed sign as the input passed each representable voltage.
examples.zh: 取最近的电平进行量化时，输入经过各个可表示电压，「量化误差」改变符号。

examples.en: We plotted the quantization error after subtracting the input voltage from each simulated output level.
examples.zh: 我们用各个模拟输出电平减去输入电压，再绘出「量化误差」。

words.enDefinition: the number of distinguishable levels of an ideal data converter, often expressed as the number of bits

examples.en: At a fixed input range, higher converter resolution gave more closely spaced code intervals in the model.
examples.zh: 固定输入范围内，模型的「转换器分辨率」越高，编码区间排列得越紧密。

examples.en: The specification states converter resolution in bits so readers can infer the nominal number of codes.
examples.zh: 规格用位数标明「转换器分辨率」，读者可据此推算标称编码数量。

words.enDefinition: the route by which a measured or processed output signal returns to an earlier point in a system

examples.en: The dotted line shows the feedback path carrying the measured temperature back to the comparison block.
examples.zh: 虚线显示「反馈通路」将实测温度送回比较模块。

examples.en: We traced the feedback path through the sensor and scaling block in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图中沿着传感器和比例换算模块追踪「反馈通路」。

words.enDefinition: a feedback connection in which the returned signal acts to oppose a deviation from a reference or operating condition

examples.en: The negative feedback loop raised the modeled heater output when the measured temperature fell below its setpoint.
examples.zh: 实测温度低于设定值时，「负反馈回路」提高了模型中的加热功率。

examples.en: We identified the negative feedback loop by following the measured output back to the subtracting input.
examples.zh: 我们顺着实测输出追踪到相减端，找出了「负反馈回路」。

collocations: stability of a negative feedback loop

words.enDefinition: a feedback connection in which the returned signal tends to reinforce a change that produced it

examples.en: The positive feedback loop made a small increase grow into a transition in the switching circuit simulation.
examples.zh: 在开关电路模拟中，「正反馈回路」使小幅增加发展为状态切换。

examples.en: We recognized the positive feedback loop because the returned signal reinforced the initial output change in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，返回信号强化了最初的输出变化，据此我们认出了「正反馈回路」。

collocations: reinforcement in a positive feedback loop

words.enDefinition: control in which the measured output is not used to adjust the action applied to the system

examples.en: The timer performed open-loop control by issuing the same command regardless of the simulated room temperature.
examples.zh: 无论模拟室温怎样变化，定时器都发出相同指令，从而实现「开环控制」。

examples.en: We compared open-loop control with a model that adjusts its command based on the measured output.
examples.zh: 我们把「开环控制」与依据实测输出调整指令的模型作比较。

words.enDefinition: control that uses measured output feedback to determine the action applied to a system

examples.en: The thermostat example shows closed-loop control because a temperature reading influences the next heating command.
examples.zh: 温控器示例中，温度读数会影响下一次加热指令，体现了「闭环控制」。

examples.en: We tested closed-loop control in simulation by changing the outside temperature and observing the indoor response.
examples.zh: 我们在模拟中改变室外温度、观察室内温度响应，测试「闭环控制」。

words.enDefinition: the desired value that a control system attempts to maintain or track

examples.en: The simulated room began warming after we raised the temperature setpoint by a small amount.
examples.zh: 我们略微提高温度「设定值」后，模拟房间开始升温。

examples.en: We plotted the measured output and the setpoint together to show how closely the model tracked it.
examples.zh: 我们同时绘出实测输出与「设定值」，展示模型跟随目标的程度。

words.enDefinition: the difference between a reference value and the measured controlled output under the stated sign convention

examples.en: The control error became positive when the modeled room temperature dropped below the reference value.
examples.zh: 设定参考量减输出为误差时，模型室温低于参考值后，「控制误差」变为正。

examples.en: The plot shows how the control error shrank after the simulated thermostat changed the heating command.
examples.zh: 情境中的温控器改变加热指令后，图中「控制误差」逐渐缩小。

words.enDefinition: the command issued by a controller to influence the system through an actuator or other input

examples.en: The controller output increased while the temperature sensor reported a value below the target in simulation.
examples.zh: 模拟中，温度传感器报告低于目标值的读数时，「控制器输出」增大。

examples.en: We plotted the controller output separately from the room temperature because they represent different quantities.
examples.zh: 我们分开绘制「控制器输出」和室温，因为它们代表不同的量。

words.enDefinition: a mathematical description of the process or physical system that a controller acts on

examples.en: We fitted the plant model to the recorded warming curve before testing feedback in the simulator.
examples.zh: 我们用记录的升温曲线拟合「被控对象模型」，随后在模拟器中测试反馈。

examples.en: The plant model describes how indoor temperature changes in response to heating and outside conditions.
examples.zh: 「被控对象模型」描述室温如何响应加热和室外条件。

words.enDefinition: an input other than the control command that affects the controlled process or its measured output

examples.en: The simulation represents an open window as a disturbance input that increases heat loss from the room.
examples.zh: 模拟把打开的窗户表示为会增加房间热损失的「扰动输入」。

examples.en: We added a disturbance input to check how quickly the temperature returned to its setpoint.
examples.zh: 我们加入「扰动输入」，检查温度恢复到设定值需要多长时间。

words.enDefinition: the output history of a system following an input that changes abruptly to a new constant level

examples.en: The step response showed the simulated temperature gradually approaching its new value after the command changed.
examples.zh: 指令改变后，「阶跃响应」显示模拟温度逐渐接近新值。

examples.en: We compared the step response of two control models after giving each the same sudden input change.
examples.zh: 我们给两个控制模型施加相同的突变输入，再比较它们的「阶跃响应」。

words.enDefinition: the time for a step response to move between two specified levels, commonly ten and ninety percent of its total change

examples.en: We measured rise time from the two threshold crossings marked on the simulated step response plot.
examples.zh: 我们用阶跃响应模拟图中标出的两个交越点测量「上升时间」。

examples.en: Both responses crossed the lower threshold together, so reaching the upper threshold sooner meant shorter rise time.
examples.zh: 两条响应同时穿过下阈值，较早达到上阈值的响应具有较短的「上升时间」。

collocations: rise time of a step response

words.enDefinition: the elapsed time after an input change until the output enters and stays within a stated tolerance of its final value

examples.en: We marked the settling time at the last entry into the shaded tolerance band on the graph.
examples.zh: 我们在图上将最后一次进入阴影容差带的时刻标为「调节时间」。

examples.en: Two models rose equally quickly, but one had a longer settling time because its oscillations persisted.
examples.zh: 两个模型上升同样快，其中一个的振荡持续较久，所以「调节时间」较长。

collocations: settling time within a stated tolerance

words.enDefinition: the maximum amount by which a transient response exceeds its final value, often reported as a percentage

examples.en: The peak overshoot was greater in the trace that climbed farther above the final level before returning.
examples.zh: 其中一条曲线在回落前超出最终值更多，因而「峰值超调量」较大。

examples.en: We reported peak overshoot as a percentage of the step change, following the worksheet's convention.
examples.zh: 根据练习的约定，我们用相对于阶跃变化量的百分比报告「峰值超调量」。

words.enDefinition: the difference between the reference and the output after transients have decayed for a specified input

examples.en: The plotted steady-state error persisted long after the simulated output stopped changing appreciably under a constant command.
examples.zh: 在恒定指令下，模拟输出早已没有明显变化，图中的「稳态误差」仍然存在。

examples.en: We estimated the steady-state error by comparing the final simulated output level with the requested level.
examples.zh: 我们把最终模拟输出电平与要求的电平比较，估算「稳态误差」。

words.enDefinition: a value of the transform variable where a system's transfer function has a singularity after cancellation of common factors

examples.en: The real system pole in the example corresponds to an exponentially decaying term in the response.
examples.zh: 例子中的实「系统极点」对应响应中的一个指数衰减项。

examples.en: We marked each system pole on the complex plane to compare the two modeled responses.
examples.zh: 我们在复平面上标出各「系统极点」，用来比较两种模拟响应。

collocations: system pole in the complex plane

words.enDefinition: a value of the transform variable at which a reduced transfer function equals zero

examples.en: The system zero came from the numerator after we removed the common factor in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 按练习消去公因式后，「系统零点」由分子确定。

examples.en: Adding a system zero changed the shape of the step response in the classroom simulation.
examples.zh: 课堂模拟中，加入一个「系统零点」改变了阶跃响应的形状。

collocations: system zero in the complex plane

words.enDefinition: in linear feedback, a system whose internal modes decay following a perturbation with the loop closed

examples.en: The stable closed-loop system returned near its original temperature after the simulated disturbance was removed.
examples.zh: 模拟扰动撤去后，「稳定闭环系统」回到了原来温度附近。

examples.en: All modeled modes decayed after a small initial perturbation in the stable closed-loop system example.
examples.zh: 在「稳定闭环系统」的示例中，受到小初始扰动后，模型的所有模态都衰减。

collocations: response of a stable closed-loop system

words.enDefinition: a pair of plots showing frequency response magnitude and phase against logarithmically scaled frequency

examples.en: The upper part of the Bode plot showed gain, while the lower part showed phase shift.
examples.zh: 「波德图」的上半部分显示增益，下半部分显示相移。

examples.en: We read the amplitude ratio from the Bode plot after locating the input frequency on its axis.
examples.zh: 我们在「波德图」的频率轴上定位输入频率，再读出振幅比。

collocations: Bode plot of a transfer function

words.enDefinition: the reciprocal of the loop gain magnitude at a phase crossover of minus 180 degrees under the usual negative feedback convention

examples.en: We read the gain margin at the marked phase crossover of the example loop response graph.
examples.zh: 我们在示例回路响应图标出的相位交越点读取「增益裕度」。

examples.en: The larger gain margin meant the modeled loop tolerated a larger gain increase before the crossover limit.
examples.zh: 较大的「增益裕度」意味着达到交越极限前，模型回路可以容许更大的增益增加。

words.enDefinition: the signed difference between the loop phase and minus 180 degrees at a unity-gain crossover under the usual negative feedback convention

examples.en: We found the phase margin by reading phase at the frequency where the loop magnitude equaled one.
examples.zh: 我们在回路幅值等于一的频率处读出相位，求得「相位裕度」。

examples.en: The second loop model had a smaller phase margin on the plotted frequency response in our exercise.
examples.zh: 在练习绘出的频率响应中，第二个回路模型的「相位裕度」较小。

words.enDefinition: a plot of possible closed-loop pole locations as a specified gain varies

examples.en: The root locus showed how the modeled poles moved as we increased the classroom controller gain.
examples.zh: 「根轨迹」显示，在课堂控制器的增益增大时，模型极点如何移动。

examples.en: We used the root locus to see whether the poles crossed into the right half of the plane.
examples.zh: 我们用「根轨迹」查看极点是否越入复平面的右半边。

words.enDefinition: a feedback controller combining actions proportional to the error, its time integral and its rate of change

examples.en: The simulation displays the three contributions to the PID controller output on separate curves for comparison.
examples.zh: 模拟将「PID 控制器」输出的三项贡献画成分开的曲线，便于比较。

examples.en: We compared the PID controller with a proportional-only model using the same simulated temperature change.
examples.zh: 我们采用相同的模拟温度变化，对比「PID 控制器」和仅采用比例作用的模型。

collocations: proportional term of a PID controller
